task_completion.description: Navigate to the Webforms module in Vtiger CRM settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Webforms' list view or the 'Add Webform' creation screen.

task_completion.description: Set the Form Name to 'B2B Landing Page', Module to 'Leads', and Return URL to 'https://www.store-example.com/thank-you'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the input fields for 'Form Name', 'Module', and 'Return URL' filled with the specified values.
The 'Assigned To' dropdown or field showing 'Admin User' selected.

task_completion.description: Include Last Name, Company, Primary Email, Phone, and Lead Source in the form fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The field list or configuration table showing these five specific fields added to the webform.
Checkboxes or toggles in the 'Required' column enabled for 'Last Name' and 'Company'.

task_completion.description: Configure 'Lead Source' as Hidden with an Override Value of 'Web Site'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Lead Source' row showing the 'Hidden' checkbox checked and the text 'Web Site' entered in the 'Override Value' column.

integrity.description: The agent used the Vtiger CRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing mouse movements, clicks on CRM buttons, and typing into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific Return URL provided, not a generic placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL 'https://www.store-example.com/thank-you' is visible in the form configuration, not 'example.com' or 'localhost'.

integrity.description: The agent actually saved the form rather than just filling it out.
integrity.visual_evidence: A 'Save' button click followed by a success message or the new form appearing in the Webforms list.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The webform must be named 'B2B Landing Page'. The target module is 'Leads'. The Return URL must be exactly 'https://www.store-example.com/thank-you'. The 'Lead Source' field must be hidden and have an override value of 'Web Site'. Required fields are 'Last Name' and 'Company'. The assigned user must be 'Admin User'.
